description: Cave Dust is a Minecraft mod that adds the white ash particle from the Basalt Deltas biome to the underground to simulate dust!

mods.name: Cave Dust
mods.description: Makes dust underground that scales with depth!

releases.notes: Fixed error in fabric.mod.json causing failure to open on 1.19.4.

mods.name: Cave Dust
mods.description: Makes dust underground that scales with depth!

releases.notes:
Particles can no longer spawn under the world.
Particles no longer spawn in blocks, instead spawning in air.
Fixed bug present since 1.2.0, which meant particle amount was dependant on blocks around player.
New particle multiplier allowing greater control of particle amount.
New F3 screen text, allows user to debug particle amount.
Removed upper and lower limit buttons.
Updated UI.

releases.notes:
In this update, I changed a bunch of stuff! Shocking really.
No but really, a whole ton of things were changed, including:
- The way particles are spawned, the spawn "check" now performs the check on the particle position instead of the player, very neat!
- Added velocity randomness slider. weeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
- Added superflat spawning toggle, since superflat worlds are hard to assume things for, they might be broken, so I left a toggle so you folks can decide to spawn them for yourselves :)
- Changed license to MPL-2.0
- Added keybinds to reload the config and toggle particle spawning! Handy!
- Changed particles so that it spawns 10 times the amount! Should be nicer to adjust now!
